features.daily_close: last completed UTC day close (16:00 8h candle); exactly three bars per day
features.beta: OLS slope with intercept: covariance of 90 daily alt/BTC log returns divided by BTC variance; no clipping; zero BTC variance rejects study
features.incremental: alt 30-day log return minus current 90-day beta times BTC 30-day log return; no subtraction of daily intercept
features.target: arithmetic alt-minus-BTC gross return in bps, Monday 08:00 open to following Monday 08:00 open

model.estimator: StandardScaler on all X fitted on training rows only then Ridge

bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive; shared-week symbols stay together; not a multiple-testing correction

controls.delayed: third model with strength delayed one weekly snapshot, identical training and baseline inputs; report only; first forecast control is unavailable because the first training row has no prior eligible weekly feature; do not trim main cohort or impute
controls.placebo: permute extended-minus-baseline forecast contribution in four-week blocks within calendar year, same mapping across symbols; keep final short block fixed
controls.interpretation: descriptive exceedance frequency, not a formal p-value; cannot select another candidate

economics.execution: Monday 08:00 UTC open to next Monday 08:00 open; close/reopen each selected week
economics.portfolio: one-third initial capital per symbol; reinvest within sleeve, no redistribution, idle cash earns zero
economics.cost_accounting: half each fill, multiplicative; stress assumptions, no historical spread/depth/account-fee calibration
comparators: BTC holdings on identical candidate exposure schedule
economics.path: held 8h candles only, excluding exit candle; intrabar order unknown
economics.session: fixed 08:00 UTC entries; no session-effect inference

decision: any state failure rejects and economics NOT_RUN; any economic failure rejects; otherwise DEVELOPMENT_INTERESTING_NOT_READY requiring separate independent venue/cost/power/unseen-confirmation design
